original_test_intent: Read selected FRU data through the raw in-band interface across valid offset/count combinations, verify returned-count semantics and validate reconstructed FRU contents without mutation.
original_method: Preserve Storage 0x0a/0x11 with explicit device, offset and requested count. Correct Review guidance derives byte/word offset units from Area Info rather than interpreting access mode as a hard-coded offset value.
manual_activity: Owner approves the target FRU device, safe read range/count matrix and field redaction once; all selected reads are bounded and non-mutating.
required_inputs: Area size and byte/word access mode
safety_requirements: Do not use plaintext sshpass or disable host verification
Never infer that access-mode 1 means offset 0x0100
Never issue an unbounded 0xf0 request without target limit validation
agent_execution_scope: Verify target/device and query area metadata
Translate logical byte ranges to protocol offsets using approved access units
Execute bounded 0x0a/0x11 reads for the matrix
Capture completion, returned count and payload for each
Redact sensitive fields and return evidence
engineer_actions: Approve safe range/count coverage and OEM parsers

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `ipmitool fru print 0` may validate decoded inventory but does not prove the raw request's offset, count or returned-count criteria and its SSH wrapper is unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected `ipmitool raw 0x0a 0x11 <device> <offset-lsb> <offset-msb> <count>` for each validated bounded vector, interpreting offset in the access units reported by 0x0a/0x10.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The original device/offset/count parameters, count-from-0x01 intent, criteria and timing remain visible; 0xf0 is gated rather than silently accepted.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a target-bounded read matrix from the exact Area Info result, verify protocol count semantics per chunk, reconstruct the selected area and validate FRU checksums/fields.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects ambiguous access-mode/offset interpretation and unsafe large-read advice in the Review layer while retaining Master unchanged.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A high-level FRU print provides supplemental decoded evidence but is not equivalent to raw 0x0a/0x11 offset/count coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Bad unit conversion can read the wrong range; large requests may exceed BMC limits; FRU contents may contain sensitive serial, asset or UUID data.

project_override_considerations: Alternate tools are acceptable only when exact device, byte range, returned length and raw or equivalent integrity evidence remain traceable. They must record whether original raw-protocol behavior is still unverified.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master appears to conflate the access-mode indicator with choosing literal offset 0x0000 or 0x0100, encourages 'as many as possible' reads and clears logs. DeepSeek replaces raw range semantics with a full high-level print. Review preserves the command while flagging and correcting these issues only in the recommendation layer.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read command and validation dimensions are explicit. Exact device, bounds, access units and parser are project execution inputs, and any malformed response can fail closed without state change.

review_improvement: Restores raw offset/count coverage, corrects access-unit handling, bounds transfer sizes, validates every returned count and adds checksum/redaction evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: This case is about protocol-level ranged reads, not merely whether FRU inventory can be displayed. Area size and access mode define legal offsets; response count defines actual bytes returned. With those invariants checked and all requests bounded, the test is safely deterministic and fully automatable.
